code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for color,fill in [(9,2),(5,7),(6,2)]:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        # Only rectangular outlines with all four edges present
        if all(g[r0][c]==color and g[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[r][c0]==color and g[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    g[r][c]=fill
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
